notes.title: 📢 MAFATE - Pre-alpha Demo v0.3.4 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147019/13d8b59f8e670138511daae45b2243899f54f5bc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

[h1]📢 MAFATE - Pre-alpha Demo v0.3.4 is LIVE![/h1]

Hello everyone! 👋  
We are beyond excited to announce that the very first [b]Pre-alpha Demo[/b] of [b]MAFATE[/b] is now available on Steam!  
This build is [i]version 0.3.4[/i] — it’s not perfect, but it’s our first big step toward bringing you into the heart of the Cirque.

We want to thank you all for your interest, support, and patience. ❤️  
Your feedback is extremely valuable, so please share your thoughts and help us improve the game by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/x6uJ5XenBv]Discord server[/url]!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🐞 Known Issues (we’re working on them!)[/h2]
- [b]Teleport bug:[/b] Leaving Marla and teleporting back to Marla can sometimes trap Elios. Opening the menu can unstuck him.
- [b]Collision bug:[/b] Certain collisions, such as roofs, may trap the player.

[b]Temporary Fix:[/b] If you get stuck, you can use the [i]"Unstuck"[/i] option.  
Go to [b]Menu → Settings → Unstuck[/b] to free your character.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]📬 We want your feedback![/h2]
We are currently in [b]Pre-alpha[/b], which means the game is still in active development.  
Your bug reports, gameplay impressions, and suggestions will help us shape the future of MAFATE.  
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/x6uJ5XenBv]Discord community[/url] to chat with us directly, report issues, and share your best screenshots!

[hr][/hr]

[i]Thank you for helping us bring the magic of MAFATE to life — one delivery at a time![/i]  
– The Blue Ramen Studios Team
